correctness.rationale: Exact contraction and commutator expansions, martingale-difference identities, h^6 squared remainder and triangular-array Lindeberg prove both weak Gaussian limit and covariance with proper normalization. The finite Krylov criterion follows from analytic semigroup and Cayley-Hamilton; 2x2 strictly positive matrices give nonzero covariance. Exact rational stage checks and exact finite-step moment recursion were independently executed from included verifier. No claim of numerical experiments proving infinite limits.
